recognize_zh: CD34 免疫染色中，陽性母細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色環形染色，零散單個分布於骨髓間質與脂肪細胞之間，數量不多、未成片；其餘造血細胞為陰性。
features: CD34 IHC with crisp membranous brown staining of scattered round mononuclear cells
Positive cells present singly, without sheets or large aggregates in this field
Positive cells small-to-intermediate with round nuclei and a thin cytoplasmic rim
Faint granular background staining and positive fragments near vessels
Majority of hematopoietic cells negative; adipocytes present
describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights scattered small-to-intermediate mononuclear cells with crisp membranous staining, present singly among negative hematopoietic cells and adipocytes. Sheets or large clusters of CD34-positive cells are not seen in this field. The CD34-positive cells should be estimated as a percentage of marrow cellularity across the entire core, since focal clustering or an increase above baseline would support progression. Findings indicate a modest population of CD34-positive precursors in this GATA2-associated myeloid neoplasm, without evidence of diffuse blast replacement in this field.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow contains fewer than about 2% scattered CD34-positive cells, so distinction rests on quantitation across the whole core.
AML shows diffuse sheets of CD34-positive blasts rather than scattered single cells.
Increased or clustered CD34-positive cells favor hypocellular MDS, whereas aplastic anemia shows markedly reduced CD34-positive cells.
